backdating.algorithm: After processing parameter inputs, the initializer copies each earliest processed leaf value to the interval from 2015-01-01 until that first value. It repeats backdating for parameters newly added or replaced by reforms.

bounded_trace_2025.definition: Parameter metadata from actual reads. Any-leaf-after-January includes within-2025 starts; any-leaf-after-December identifies raw histories unavailable throughout 2025.

kind: Parameter-history and tracing metadata; no population findings
limits: Counts measure traced parameter nodes, not laws, programs, incorrect outcomes, or households affected.
First raw history date does not establish enactment, a policy change, or an incorrect historical value.
Backdating fills missing histories; it does not reconstruct historical law.
Scale leaves or whole programs can be inactive despite parameter reads.
This bounded trace is not exhaustive statutory validation, an administrative benefit benchmark, or a national sensitivity run.
No explicit post-2025 read occurred in the bounded trace; unvisited paths remain unaudited.
The 2017 and 2025 traces use different sample sizes and scenario construction, so count differences do not measure comparative accuracy.
No actual 2025 output error or its materiality was demonstrated.
No survey records, IDs, weights, population totals, or private paths are included.
